import re

_G_PER_UNIT = {
    "g": 1.0,
    "kg": 1000.0,
    "lb": 453.59237,
    "oz": 28.349523125,
}

_WEIGHT_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(g|kg|lb|oz)\s*$", re.IGNORECASE)


def parse_weight(text: str) -> int:
    """Package weight in whole grams, e.g. "1.2 kg", " 12 OZ " -> 5443, 340."""
    match = _WEIGHT_RE.match(text)
    if match is None:
        raise ValueError(f"invalid package weight: {text!r}")
    value = float(match.group(1))
    grams = value * _G_PER_UNIT[match.group(2).lower()]
    return int(round(grams))
